decision: T10 indexation recovery (lead decision, reversible). Pages stay live at the same URL with HTTP 200; nothing is deleted or redirected.
undo: Remove a slug from `noindex` (or a row from `canonical`), run `node scripts/generate-news-search-state.mjs` in pilot-01-prototype, deploy. The page returns to index,follow and to the sitemaps on the next request.

window.source: GSC Search Analytics, page dimension, dataState=all, every locale URL of the slug

exclusions: hard-coded /news/<slug> link from a curated page in src/, worker/ or server/
policy.noindex: robots noindex,follow (meta + head), removed from sitemap-articles-*.xml, news-sitemap.xml, hreflang alternates and llms lists
policy.canonical: rel=canonical to the stronger article, robots index,follow, removed from sitemaps
